news.title: Four CSE faculty receive National Science Foundation CAREER Awards
news.summary_en: Four University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering researchers have received National Science Foundation (NSF) Faculty Early Career Development (CAREER) Awards to pursue innovative research and educate the next generation of scientists and engineers.

news.title: Pass it on: How CSE mentors help students build their futures
news.summary_en: Mentorship connects University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering (CSE) students with alumni and professionals who can help them navigate careers, build confidence and prepare for the workforce — and gives mentors a meaningful way to pass what they’ve learned to the next generation.

news.title: Chemistry professor Edgar Arriaga named Fulbright-Aalto University Distinguished Chair
news.summary_en: University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering (CSE) Professor Edgar Arriaga has been named a Fulbright-Aalto University Distinguished Chair for the 2026–27 academic year.

news.title: Lasers and gold — and a doctorate — draw graduate student to Minnesota
news.summary_en: After she earning her Ph.D. from the University of Minnesota in May, MaKenna Koble was named among the prestigious Arnold O. Beckman 2026 Postdoctoral Fellows in Chemical Instrumentation.
